org_similarity_list.target_short_description: Klarna is a global digital bank and flexible payments provider.
Afterpay allows shoppers to receive products immediately and pay in four simple installments over a short period of time.
Affirm is a financial technology services company that offers installment loans to consumers at the point of sale.
Zip is an online payments technology provider that offers consumers credit options for online shopping.
Sezzle provides a buy now, pay later solution platform.
Splitit is a payment method solution enabling customers to pay for purchases with an existing credit card.
PayPal is a financial service company that provides online payment solutions to its users worldwide.
Tabby is a payments and shopping app that enables customers to make purchases and pay for them in installments.
Uplift is an enterprise buy now, pay later solution offering a complete range of personalized payment options.
Bread Financial is a financial services company.
Perpay, a Certified B Corp, is a FinTech app providing underserved consumers ability to build credit.
